d: Long, flowing pale blonde hair with straight bangs and a single braided lock draped over the shoulder. Sharp, narrow red eyes with a cold expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white and gold ornate sleeveless dress with a high blue collar, paired with a large, flowing white cape lined with deep blue, black thigh-high boots, and black leggings. A glowing cyan energy sword is held in the right hand.
